title: (a) If the owner of an Indian ship fails to
text:
104. (a) If the owner of an Indian ship fails to

comply with clause (a) of sub-section
(1) of section 319, or

(b) If a master fails to comply with clause

(b) of sub-section (1), or
clause (a) or clause (b) of subsection (2) of section 319.
